:::{#def-indicator-vector}
#### Indicator vector / standard basis vector

The $j$-th **indicator vector** (or *standard basis vector*) $\vecf{e}_j$
of length $p$ has a $1$ in position $j$ and $0$s elsewhere:

$$
(\vecf{e}_j)_i =
\begin{cases}
1 & \text{if } i = j \\
0 & \text{if } i \neq j
\end{cases}
\qquad
\vecf{e}_j =
\begin{bmatrix}
0 \\
\vdots \\
0 \\
1 \\
0 \\
\vdots \\
0
\end{bmatrix}
\leftarrow \text{position } j
$$

:::
